extraction_scope: Worker-6 final mechanism ontology repaired from primary figure captions and Results/Discussion; hypotheses are not promoted to direct mechanisms.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: ZmD32 directly binds multiple phospholipid classes in a membrane lipid strip/protein-lipid overlay assay; this supports a lipid-binding interaction, not a complete membrane-lysis mechanism.
mechanism_claims.limitations: The assay identifies lipid binding specificity; it does not by itself prove microbial membrane disruption.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: CFU time-course data support fungicidal activity against C. albicans, with slower killing when 100 mM NaCl is present.
mechanism_claims.limitations: This is a killing-kinetics activity mode, not a molecular target assignment.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The authors discuss cationic charge density and microbial cell-wall access as a salt-tolerance explanation; this remains interpretive context rather than a direct assay-proven mechanism.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Do not annotate as direct_mechanism; source frames it as an explanatory hypothesis.
